stoppingRule: Run all eight declared attempts. Verify three independent clients and all 2000 canonical records for a queued stale update against a server-accepted peer update or delete. Zero uses the existing title-only application mutator that ignores absent rows, retaining application version 1; Syncular uses explicit version preconditions. Include live replay and canonical 5/25-reader connected-delivery regressions because native mutation receipt collection is shared. Preserve failures and separate configured policy profiles. This single-trial smoke cannot establish performance rankings.
